data.narrative:
MineSense Technologies, a Growth-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector, has raised over $100M to date. The comparable universe consists of one public peer (LNZA) and eight private companies operating in the same sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, peer median valuation analysis was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set—only a single datapoint met filtering criteria, falling short of the minimum threshold of three required for reliable median triangulation.

The stage-progression method was the primary applicable approach. Using the $100M total capital raised as a baseline value proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical for progression from Growth stage, the method yields an implied valuation of $120M. This represents a measured 20% appreciation over total capital deployed, consistent with typical interim valuation movement at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $102M to $138M, centered at $120M median. Key uncertainties stem from the absence of narrow-set peer anchors; the single applicable method limits confidence in precision. A more robust triangulation would require additional same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables in Climate & Energy to cross-validate the stage-progression result through independent peer metrics. Management should be prepared to discuss capital efficiency and revenue trajectory to support movement within or beyond this range.
